test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the instrument of monetary policy used by the RBI?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bank rate.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** instrument of monetary policy **used by the RBI is the **Bank rate.**
 
• Bank rate is the rate at which** RBI lends money to commercial banks** for meeting their liquidity needs.
 
• This rate is used by RBI to influence the** lending rates of commercial banks **and thereby control the money supply in the economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Base rate** is the** minimum rate **below which banks** cannot lend **to their customers and is determined by individual banks based on their **cost of funds.**

 
 
• It is **not **a tool of monetary policy used by RBI.
 
 
 
• **Call rate **is the rate at which banks** borrow funds from each other** for short periods of time and is used for managing their day-to-day liquidity needs.
 
 
• It is **not **a tool of monetary policy used by RBI.
 
 
 
• **Discount rate** is the rate at which commercial banks can** borrow money from RBI** by pledging their securities as collateral.
 
 
• It is **not** a commonly used tool of monetary policy by RBI.
